A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' was a member of the [[Star Cabal]] during [[3640 BBY]]. He was wearing the uniform of an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] officer while participating with other members through a holo-conference when the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] in the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] got attacked by [[Cipher Nine]] and the remainder of the Imperial Intelligence.
